Подключает камеры и звонки Reolink к ViO: Connects Reolink cameras and doorbells to ViON over Reolink's own Baichuan protocol: device discovery, live view, two-way audio, and motion, object, battery and doorbell events.
A camera that cannot send its video in t: A camera that cannot send its video in time falls behind. Once the picture trails live by this many seconds, the old pictures are skipped and the stream continues at the next full frame. Skipped seconds are missing from recordings too, so set 0 to keep everything and accept the delay.
Battery cameras are left alone between e: Battery cameras are left alone between events so they can sleep, and report what they see on their own. Turn this on if the camera is wired permanently, for example a doorbell on its bell transformer. It then keeps a connection like a mains camera, which reacts faster and opens the live view quicker, but would empty a battery within a day.

Reolink UID, used for broadcast connecti: Reolink UID, used to reach the camera by local network broadcast when no IP is set. Changes apply after a plugin restart.
Username of the camera's local account. Changes apply after a plugin restart.
Password of the camera's local account. Changes apply after a plugin restart.
Local port the embedded RTSP bridge list: Local port the plugin's built-in RTSP bridge listens on (reachable from the server itself only). Restart the plugin after changing it.
Port battery cameras push their events t: Port battery cameras push their events to (must be reachable from the camera network). Restart the plugin after changing it.
Add a camera manually when LAN discovery: Add a camera manually when the search in the local network cannot reach it (different subnet, or battery camera by UID).
Camera IP for a direct connection (Baich: Camera IP for a direct connection (Baichuan, TCP port 9000).
Reolink UID for local broadcast connecti: Reolink UID for reaching the camera by local network broadcast (same network segment only). Used when no IP is set.
Adds the camera to the discovered list;: Puts the camera on the list of discovered cameras; add it from there with its username and password.
